technique_name: Generate a possible future for humankind if artificial intelligence (AI) becomes more advanced and prevalent.
description: If AI becomes more advanced and prevalent, it could revolutionize our lives by enabling us to automate mundane and hazardous tasks. AI will also lead to the development of smarter robots and machines that could assist us in everyday life. AI can also help develop innovative solutions to pressing global issues such as climate change, pandemics, and even aging.
